text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty autopage fired: high 5xx spike on inference-gateway-prod-east1 (alert: INFER_GW_5XX_RATE > 0.75% over 1m). PD Incident: INC1234567. Auto-ack policy: 5m.

sophie: acked via PD — taking first touch. :wave: Seeing initial 1.9% 502/503 rate on edge for the last 2m. Customers reporting intermittent failures. Can someone check canary and model fallback?

raj: on it. pulling traces now. quick check: are we seeing a KV cache stall or backend timeouts?

sophie: logs show repeated upstream reset from model-host-2: "grpc: received RST_STREAM". Also a small surge of long-tail requests hitting seq=2048.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: Inference Gateway 5xx. Steps:
1) Verify canary health: `curl -I https://canary.east1.internal/health`
2) Increase gateway replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gw -n prod --replicas=6`
3) Remove noisy node: `kubectl cordon model-host-2 && kubectl drain model-host-2 --ignore-daemonsets`
4) Route traffic to fallback-model: update route table or set model override in config

sophie: Doing step 1 & 2 now. rolling upscale to 6.

(small code block)
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-gw
# pod inference-gw-5  Running  2/2  25m
# pod inference-gw-6  Pending  0/2  1s
```

raj: Traces show increased p50/p95 latencies hitting model-host-2 and a spike of OOM-kills historically during heavy KV cache flushes. I think node is overloaded — cordon/drain recommended.

sophie: cordon/drain issued. Starting a control-plane model rebalancing, and warming standby hosts with `curl -X POST https://ops-api.warmup/hosts` to prefill KV cache. Also enabling temporary retry-mitigation: set `RETRY_BACKOFF_MS=200` on gateway.

pagerduty: Senior escalation: paged raj-senior at +1m (policy: 2nd-tier after 5m). :rotating_light:

raj: got the senior page, joining.

liam: incoming on-call for next shift at 2300 UTC — will take over handoff once we reach stable. Please add a short summary when handing off.

sophie: quick customer-impact check: error budget burn ~0.5% for last 15m; major affected orgs: Acme Co (API keys 3xx), BetaApps — sales notified.

sophie: Mitigation status: scaled gw to 6 (success), cordoned model-host-2, drain in progress, traffic shifted to model-host-4/5. KV warmup triggered. 5xx rate dropping to ~0.4% — still above threshold. keeping PD incident open.

raj: temp policy: enable fallback-model for 10% of traffic via weight override. Patch snippet:
```
PATCH /api/v1/routes/override
{ "route": "infer-prod", "model_weight": {"fallback-model": 0.1} }
```
Applied.

sophie: after fallback, 5xx down to 0.15% over 5m. customer retries also reduced. will monitor for 30m.

liam: if stabilized, plan to close PD and open a follow-up ticket for root-cause (probable overloaded model-host + cache eviction). I'll do the postmortem draft tomorrow morning.

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: attach logs and traces to INC1234567 and tag with `root_cause_candidate: kv-cache-stall`.

sophie: adding notes to PD, and listing runbook steps we ran. handing off to liam in 20m if metrics keep trending down. :white_check_mark:

liam: acknowledged — will take over at 2300 UTC. leave PD unacked until handoff complete.

sophie: final check: using `curl` to health endpoints looks clean; errors reduced. closing loop in 20m if steady.

incident-bot: Autopage update: rate now 0.12% (1m). No further PD escalations.

(END THREAD)
